question: Which exact upstream value-path writers and downstream Q/K/V/MLP interfaces are geometrically compatible with the cross-fitted rank-one head-response projectors?

searched: temporal_iswas rank4 upstream weight-edge atlases v1-v2
iswas MLP8 downstream Q8 and source-position weight atlases
temporal/iswas canonical downstream reader and complete module atlases
prior_art.novelty: Earlier weight atlases translate older Q8/residual task modes or rank-four source programs. None translates the newly selected four independent 128-dimensional head-response projectors from target-feasible DAS.
prior_art.scope_limit: Pure weight geometry cannot prove an activation-conditioned causal reader or writer. All rankings remain diagnostic until sealed construction transfer and reset/rescue validate them.

frozen_design.forward_map: For head h at layer l, residual write w_lh = W_O[l][:, h*128:(h+1)*128] u_lh.
frozen_design.downstream_score: For each later attention factor matrix A and same/later-layer MLP input matrix M, report ||A w||/(||A||_F ||w||) or ||M w||/(||M||_F ||w||).
frozen_design.value_pullback: v_lh = W_V[l,h]^T u_lh; rank earlier attention W_O slices and MLP Down matrices by ||v^T W||/(||v|| ||W||_F). This covers the value path only, not QK routing.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_map_finiteness_an: All authorities match, eight W_O embedding closures are <=1e-7, sign-gauge scores are invariant <=1e-12, all scores are finite, and the declared zero-forward price is exact.
predictions.pred_b_reader_rankings_are_fold_stable: For every source, Spearman correlation between the two full downstream reader rankings is at least .80.
predictions.pred_c_known_l15_readers_are_enriched: For each fold, at least one of L15H1 or L15H5 is in the top downstream quartile for at least three of four sources.
predictions.pred_d_sources_converge_on_shared_downst: In each fold, at least one exact reader label is in the top ten for at least three of four sources.
predictions.pred_e_known_serial_value_writers_are_en: L8H1 is top-quartile for at least one L9 target in both folds, and at least one of L9H1/L9H4 is top-quartile for L11H3 in both folds.

decision: If fold-stable shared readers are found, preregister causal reset/rescue only after a projector passes construction transfer. If rankings are unstable or diffuse, weight translation cannot rescue the current subspace claim.
